prompt: You have stayed at a friend’s house last weekend. You think you have left your watch there. Thank your friend describe your watch tell me what you want him to do write 150 words.
essay:
Dear Alex,

Thank you very much for inviting me over to your house in Toronto last weekend. It was a wonderful time celebrating your promotion at work and catching up with you and your family.

While it was a sombre time for us all, I will have to bother you with a request. I forgot my personal watch over there. I removed it before bed , and I left it on the dark brown table to the right of the bed. The table was near the window. It will be a stainless steel watch by Tissot with a green border design. If it is not there, then you can also check the coffee table in the hall.

If you find it, can you please mail it to my address at 45 Silverstone Drive in Etobicoke? My postal code is 1M6 3E5. If you cannot post it, then I can drop by to pick it up as well. If that is more feasible for you, then let me know what time works best for you this week.

Again, congratulations on your new role at work and my utmost apologies for this inconvenience. I look forward to your reply, Alex!

Best wishes,

Aditya
